row.title: Probes checked that jobs ran, not that results arrived
row.body: On 2026-11-25 the owner found about nine problems first (unposted papers, papers missing from search, /live at 0, frozen pages, a red seed sync, Facebook and Instagram failing 8 of 8, no Replication Ledger sitemap). Every probe was a liveness probe. Fix: OUTCOME-PROBE-1 selftest --outcomes on every domain, CHANNEL-BREAKER-1, OWNER-FIRST-1 ledger plus meta-loop kind, selftest --effects baseline 107, seed copy and daily workflow.

title: Probes checked that jobs ran, not that results arrived
